summary: Phase 0 (signature refactoring) completed: added atomMap, char_k, char_k_correct parameters to nf_2var_existential_transfer, nf_2var_from_interval_data, and nf_2var_transfer. Build passes. Phase 1 (Bridge A) BLOCKED by fundamental circularity: the EF game machinery requires formula_agreement on ALL StaviFormulas of depth <= k, which presupposes stavi_expressive_completeness (the theorem being proved). Six approaches were attempted and all fail for the same reason. Four resolution paths identified, with NF Type Game as most promising.
blockers: The EF game's formula_agreement (agreement on ALL StaviFormulas of depth <= k) is circular when used inside the proof of stavi_expressive_completeness. char_k_correct only provides agreement on char_k IMAGES, not all StaviFormulas. Converting from char_k-image agreement to full StaviFormula agreement IS expressive completeness.

resolution_paths: Path A: NF Type Game -- define simplified game on NormalForm types, avoiding circularity (most promising, ~300 lines)
Path B: Mutual induction restructuring -- prove expressiveness at depth k before inductive step (major refactor)
Path C: Direct sub-interval composition -- iterated zone matching with depth induction (blocked by sub-interval splitting)
Path D: Discrete specialization -- add IsSuccArchimedean hypothesis (loses generality)

artifacts.summary: Revised plan with Phase 0 completed, Phase 1 blocked
Comprehensive blocker analysis with 6 attempted approaches and 4 resolution paths
